title: 成都火锅第一口，先烫毛肚｜七上八下十五秒 First Bite of Chengdu Hotpot
description:
红油翻滚，第一筷子，成都人先夹毛肚。七上八下——下锅、提起，反复十来次，大约十五秒，叶片轻轻卷起，那一口脆得能听见响。为什么是十五秒？沸水里涮够这个时间，既杀得掉大部分致病菌，又刚好停在毛肚最脆嫩的那一刻。成都人尝一口，只会说三个字——巴适得板。

In Chengdu, the first thing a hotpot regular reaches for is mao du (ox tripe). The ritual is called qi shang ba xia — in and out of the boiling red oil about a dozen times, roughly fifteen seconds, until the edges just curl. Fifteen seconds is the sweet spot: long enough in 100°C broth to kill most pathogens, short enough to keep the tripe crisp and tender. A Chengdu local sums it up in three words — ba shi de ban, perfectly, wonderfully good.
